components.title: Filter returned orders
components.what: Select all rows from orders where status is 'returned'.

components.title: Dedupe exact repeats
components.what: Check filtered rows for exact duplicate order_id+fields and remove repeats before summing.

components.title: Sum units
components.what: Sum the units column across the deduplicated returned-order rows to get total units.
